_comment: Visual settings for the portfolio. Content lives in resume.tex;
per-project display flags live in projects.js; this file holds only
how things LOOK. The dev-server editor writes this file, and keeps a
timestamped copy under .site-config-backups/ so changes can be reverted.
Any key may be omitted — the site falls back to the stylesheet value.
light/dark: CSS variable overrides per theme, e.g. {"accent": "#8a5a44"}.
domains: an explicit colour per project domain. Drives that domain's
filter button, its chips, the card edge AND the connector lines drawn
to matching projects. Unpinned domains get a hue-rotated accent.
recent: colour history shown in the editor.

sizes._comment: Multipliers applied on top of the stylesheet. 1 = unchanged.

sections._comment: Per-section overrides. Keys match \section*{...} names in resume.tex.

_comment: imageDir: where image files live, relative to the site root.
icons/images/alts: per-section and per-project OVERRIDES set from the
editor, keyed by name. These win over the icon:/image:/alt: lines in
resume.tex, so the editor never has to rewrite your LaTeX. Use the
editor's 'copy for resume.tex' button to promote a choice into the
source file, then delete it here.
